services.name: Group Tours & Field Trips
services.desc: The Museum encourages school groups, summer camps, sport teams, civic groups and other organizations to take advantage of its many interactive exhibits and history of our Mississippi athletes. We offers groups of 12 or more a discounted $3 per person rate, regardless of age. Teachers and bus drivers are admitted free. Reservations are strongly encouraged. School groups are divided into smaller groups and rotate throughout the Museum with the aid of Museum volunteers. A scavenger hunt is available for students to search for answers to Mississippi sports questions, adding more structure to the tour.Food Service is available with advanced arrangements. Contact the Museum for more information.

services.name: Museum Rental
services.desc: Membership is vital to the Mississippi Sports Hall of Fame as the Museum receives no government support for its operations. The Museum offers a variety of membership levels to accommodate all budgets and is a 501©3 private, non-profit tax exempt corporation so all support is tax-deductible to the full extent allowed by law. The Mississippi Sports Hall of Fame and Museum celebrates the Magnolia State’s incredibly rich history of producing world-class athletes and teams. The mission of the Mississipi Sports Hall of Fame & Museum is to preserve, protect and promote Mississippi’s rich sports heritage for this and future
